detail.body:
## What

Adds a **parameter-free QK-Norm** (unit-RMS `RMSNorm`) on the **decoupled-RoPE** q/k of Multi-Latent Attention, applied before `apply_rotary_pos_emb`.

## Why

In MLA the q/k are split into a **content** part (`qk_head_dim`) and a **decoupled-RoPE** part (`qk_pos_emb_head_dim`). The content part is normalized (`q_layernorm`/`kv_layernorm` on the compressed latents), but the **rotary part is never normalized** — it is projected, split off, and fed straight into `apply_rotary_pos_emb`.

In a KDA/MLA hybrid this is a divergence mechanism: the rotary component's magnitude grows with training until it dominates the per-head attention logits and blows up the deep residual stream. `qk_clip` (MuonClip) does **not** catch it — `qk_clip` rescales the per-head weights (content q/k and the rotary q rows), but the rotary key `k_pos_emb` comes straight out of `linear_kv_down_proj`, is shared by all heads, and is never rescaled or normalized, so the rotary logit term grows through it and the logits climb past any threshold.

Observed in a 3B KDA-RoPE hybrid: with `qk_clip` active and its threshold holding the *clipped* logit, training still diverged; per-layer instrumentation showed the deepest residual layers exploding together while the raw attention logits shot well past the clip threshold — i.e. the runaway came through the rotary path.

## Fix

Normalize `q_pos_emb` and `k_pos_emb` to **unit RMS** over `qk_pos_emb_head_dim` before RoPE. RoPE is a rotation, so this bounds the rotary logit contribution at `qk_pos_emb_head_dim` (`mscale² · qk_pos_emb_head_dim` with YaRN, whose cos/sin carry the `mscale` factor) regardless of projection-weight growth.

- **Parameter-free** (no learnable gain): adds no parameters, so the `state_dict` and distributed-optimizer shard layout are unchanged and **existing checkpoints resume unchanged**.
- **Targeted**: only the rotary (pos) component is normalized; the content path is untouched.

## Implementation

Source-string patch on `MLASelfAttention.get_query_key_value_tensors` (the non-fused path), consistent with the existing `patches/` convention. `PrimusMLASelfAttention` inherits the method unchanged, so patching the base class covers the hybrid.

- **Enable**: `mla_rope_qk_norm` config flag, or `PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1` (no config-schema change required).
- **Scope**: non-fused RoPE path (`apply_rope_fusion: false`, `cache_mla_latents: false`). The patch logs a warning and no-ops when RoPE fusion is in effect (the fused kernel applies rotary internally). It judges the effective value: `before_train` runs before Megatron's `validate_args`, which drops `apply_rope_fusion` unless `position_embedding_type: rope`, so the MLA hybrids' inherited `apply_rope_fusion: true` (with `position_embedding_type: none`) does not skip it. It also no-ops when `cache_mla_latents=True`, and for NoPE MLA (`mla_use_nope`, the Kimi K3 default), whose positional dims are an unrotated pass-through that must stay bit-exact, and when `qk_pos_emb_head_dim` is 0 (nothing to normalize).
- **Fail-fast**: if the patch is enabled but cannot be installed (e.g. upstream source drift breaks the anchor), the run aborts instead of silently training without it.
- **Default off** → no behavior change for existing configs.

## Testing

Enabled on the 3B KDA-RoPE hybrid: the max attention logit dropped from ~5,600 to ~65, and training passed cleanly through the iteration where it previously diverged (grad flat ~0.1, zero grad-norm spikes), with loss at/below the pre-divergence baseline.

Unit tests (`tests/unit_tests/backends/megatron/test_mla_rope_qk_norm_patches.py`, 20 pass in `rocm/primus:v26.5` on MI355X against the pinned Megatron-LM): anchor still matches upstream; rewrite lands on the defining base class even when the module attribute is rebound to a subclass, and is idempotent; enable condition and all four skip guards; the config flag enables the patch on the shipped `zebra_kda_1B_hybrid.yaml` through the runtime's arg build and params merge; install failure aborts; and a numerical test on a tiny real `MLASelfAttention` checks that the patched method feeds unit-RMS q/k into the rotary embedding while the content q/k and the value are bit-identical to the unpatched method.

+### Stability: decoupled-RoPE MLA (`qk_clip` + QK-Norm)
+
+Decoupled-RoPE MLA hybrids (`qk_pos_emb_head_dim > 0`) can diverge as the rotary q/k grow — the attention logits and deep residual explode (a finite blow-up that never `NaN`s). The NoPE arm is unaffected. Two stabilizers, both **off by default**:
+
+| Flag / env var | Default | Purpose |
+|---|---|---|
+| `mla_rope_qk_norm` / `PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1` | `false` / `0` | **The fix** ([#1176](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1176)): parameter-free unit-RMS on the decoupled-RoPE q/k before RoPE, capping the rotary logit contribution that bypasses `q_layernorm`/`kv_layernorm` and escapes `qk_clip` (which rescales per-head q/k weights but never the shared rotary key from `linear_kv_down_proj`). Env var needs no config-schema change; parameter-free so checkpoints resume unchanged. Applies only to the non-fused, non-cached RoPE path: it skips itself (with a log line) when RoPE fusion is in effect (`apply_rope_fusion` with `position_embedding_type: rope`; the hybrid configs' inherited `apply_rope_fusion: true` is dropped by Megatron for `position_embedding_type: none`), when `cache_mla_latents` or `mla_use_nope` (Kimi K3's default) is set, or when `qk_pos_emb_head_dim` is 0. |
+| `qk_clip` | `false` | MuonClip safety net: rescale a head's q/k weights when its max logit exceeds the threshold. |
+| `qk_clip_threshold` | `100` | Max-logit ceiling that triggers clipping; set just above the healthy per-step max. |
+| `qk_clip_alpha` | `0.5` | Rescale split (q × `eta^alpha`, k × `eta^(1-alpha)`); in (0, 1). |
+| `log_max_attention_logit` | `false` | Log per-step max logit (implied by `qk_clip`); use it to pick the threshold. |
+
+```yaml
+mla_rope_qk_norm: true      # or: export PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1
+qk_clip: true
+qk_clip_threshold: 100      # QK-Norm keeps the healthy max logit around 65; without it, use a much higher ceiling
+qk_clip_alpha: 0.5
+log_max_attention_logit: true
+```
+

+###############################################################################

+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""
+MLA decoupled-RoPE QK-Norm Patch
+================================
+
+In Multi-Latent Attention the query/key are split into a *content* part
+(``qk_head_dim``) and a *decoupled RoPE* part (``qk_pos_emb_head_dim``). The
+content part is normalized (``q_layernorm`` / ``kv_layernorm`` on the
+compressed latents), but the **rotary part is not normalized anywhere**: it is
+projected, split off, and fed straight into ``apply_rotary_pos_emb``.
+
+For the 3B KDA-RoPE hybrid this is the divergence mechanism. Per-layer
+instrumentation showed that around iter ~22k the deepest ~7 residual layers
+(L49-L55) blow up *together* while the attention logits shoot to 16k-37k --
+far past the ``qk_clip`` threshold (5500). ``qk_clip`` cannot hold them: it
+rescales the per-head weights (content q/k and the rotary q rows of
+``linear_q_(up_)proj``), but the rotary key ``k_pos_emb`` comes straight out of
+``linear_kv_down_proj``, is shared by all heads, and is never rescaled or
+normalized, so the rotary logit term grows through it without bound and
+detonates the deep residual stream.
+
+Fix: apply a **parameter-free RMSNorm** (unit RMS over ``qk_pos_emb_head_dim``)
+to ``q_pos_emb`` and ``k_pos_emb`` before the rotary embedding. Rotary is a
+rotation, so this caps the rotary logit contribution at
+``qk_pos_emb_head_dim`` (``mscale**2 * qk_pos_emb_head_dim`` with YaRN, whose
+cos/sin carry the ``mscale`` factor) regardless of projection-weight growth --
+the real, architectural fix rather than another logit-threshold band-aid.
+
+Why parameter-free (no learnable gain): the run resumes mid-training from an
+existing checkpoint. A learnable RMSNorm gain would add new parameters and
+change the ``state_dict`` / distributed-optimizer param layout, breaking a
+clean resume. Unit-RMS with no parameters keeps the checkpoint and optimizer
+shards byte-compatible while still capping the runaway.
+
+Scope: this rewrites the non-fused training/eval path
+(``apply_rope_fusion: false``, ``cache_mla_latents: false``), which is what the
+hybrid uses. The patch logs a warning and no-ops when RoPE fusion is in effect
+(the fused kernel applies rotary internally; the hybrids' inherited
+``apply_rope_fusion: true`` does not count, since Megatron drops it for
+``position_embedding_type: none``), when MLA latents are cached (a
+different q/k path this anchor was not written for), for NoPE MLA
+(``mla_use_nope``, the Kimi K3 default), whose 64 positional dims are an
+unrotated pass-through that must stay bit-exact, and when
+``qk_pos_emb_head_dim`` is 0 (nothing to normalize).
+
+This is a "source-string rewrite" patch (see ``_source_patch_utils``): the edit
+sits in the middle of ``MLASelfAttention.get_query_key_value_tensors``'s nested
+``qkv_up_proj_and_rope_apply``, where a wrapping monkey-patch cannot reach.
+``PrimusMLASelfAttention`` inherits this method unchanged, so patching the base
+``MLASelfAttention`` covers the hybrid too.
+
+Enabled via the ``mla_rope_qk_norm`` config flag, or the
+``PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1`` env var (so it needs no config-schema change); a
+no-op otherwise.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._patch_guard import is_patched, mark_patched
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._source_patch_utils import patch_method_source
+from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, get_args, register_patch
+from primus.core.utils.module_utils import log_rank_0
+
+_PATCH_KEY = "megatron.transformer.mla_rope_qk_norm"
+
+# Anchor: the non-fused q/k split immediately followed by the rotary apply on
+# the query. We insert a parameter-free RMSNorm on the decoupled-RoPE q/k parts
+# between the split and the rotary embedding. Written at the upstream file's
+# absolute (16-space) indentation -- patch_method_source replaces on the raw,
+# non-dedented source.
+_ORI = """\
+                # k_no_pe: [num_tokens, n, qk_head_dim]
+                # value: [num_tokens, n, v_head_dim]
+                k_no_pe, value = torch.split(
+                    kv, [self.config.qk_head_dim, self.config.v_head_dim], dim=-1
+                )
+
+                # q_pos_emb: [num_tokens, n, qk_pos_emb_head_dim]
+                q_pos_emb = apply_rotary_pos_emb("""
+
+_NEW = """\
+                # k_no_pe: [num_tokens, n, qk_head_dim]
+                # value: [num_tokens, n, v_head_dim]
+                k_no_pe, value = torch.split(
+                    kv, [self.config.qk_head_dim, self.config.v_head_dim], dim=-1
+                )
+
+                # --- MLA decoupled-RoPE QK-Norm (parameter-free) ---
+                # The rotary q/k parts bypass q_layernorm/kv_layernorm and also
+                # escape qk_clip, so their magnitude can grow unbounded and drive
+                # the attention-logit / deep-residual explosion. Normalize each
+                # head's rotary vector to unit RMS (rotary is a rotation, so this
+                # bounds the rotary logit contribution at qk_pos_emb_head_dim,
+                # times mscale**2 under YaRN) without adding parameters -- keeps
+                # the checkpoint/optimizer layout identical for a clean resume.
+                _qkn_eps = self.config.layernorm_epsilon
+                q_pos_emb = q_pos_emb * torch.rsqrt(
+                    q_pos_emb.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + _qkn_eps
+                ).to(q_pos_emb.dtype)
+                k_pos_emb = k_pos_emb * torch.rsqrt(
+                    k_pos_emb.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + _qkn_eps
+                ).to(k_pos_emb.dtype)
+
+                # q_pos_emb: [num_tokens, n, qk_pos_emb_head_dim]
+                q_pos_emb = apply_rotary_pos_emb("""
+
+
+def _install_mla_rope_qk_norm_patch() -> None:
+    from megatron.core.transformer.multi_latent_attention import MLASelfAttention
+
+    # Another patch may rebind this module attribute to a subclass
+    # (PrimusMLASelfAttention). ``get_query_key_value_tensors`` is defined on the
+    # upstream base and prebuilt hybrid layers may be base instances, so patch the
+    # class that actually defines the method (walk the MRO) rather than whatever
+    # the attribute currently points at.
+    target = next(c for c in MLASelfAttention.__mro__ if "get_query_key_value_tensors" in c.__dict__)
+
+    if is_patched(target, _PATCH_KEY):
+        log_rank_0(f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] already applied; skipping.")
+        return
+
+    patch_method_source(target, "get_query_key_value_tensors", _ORI, _NEW)
+
+    mark_patched(target, _PATCH_KEY)
+    log_rank_0(
+        f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] Applied parameter-free RMSNorm to the MLA "
+        "decoupled-RoPE q/k components (non-fused path)."
+    )
+
+
+def _enabled(ctx: PatchContext) -> bool:
+    args = get_args(ctx)
+    # Enable via the ``mla_rope_qk_norm`` config flag if present, or the
+    # ``PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1`` env var (works without a config-schema change).
+    if not getattr(args, "mla_rope_qk_norm", False) and os.environ.get("PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM", "0") != "1":
+        return False
+    # The fused RoPE kernel applies rotary internally; this source patch only
+    # covers the explicit non-fused split path. Warn + no-op if fusion is on.
+    # This runs before Megatron's validate_args (called inside pretrain), which
+    # forces apply_rope_fusion off unless position_embedding_type == "rope". The
+    # MLA hybrids inherit apply_rope_fusion: true with position_embedding_type:
+    # none and still run the non-fused MLA rotary path, so judge the effective value.
+    rope_fused = (
+        getattr(args, "apply_rope_fusion", False)
+        and getattr(args, "position_embedding_type", "rope") == "rope"
+    )
+    if rope_fused:
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] apply_rope_fusion=True; QK-Norm patch only "
+            "supports the non-fused path -- skipping (rotary q/k stay unnormalized)."
+        )
+        return False
+    if getattr(args, "cache_mla_latents", False):
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] cache_mla_latents=True; QK-Norm patch only "
+            "supports the non-cached path -- skipping (rotary q/k stay unnormalized)."
+        )
+        return False
+    # NoPE MLA (Kimi K3) still routes its positional dims through this block but
+    # relies on a zero-width rotary table being a bit-exact pass-through, so
+    # normalizing them would change the model. KimiK3TransformerConfig defaults
+    # mla_use_nope to True, so a K3 run without the arg is NoPE too.
+    use_nope = getattr(args, "mla_use_nope", None)
+    if use_nope is None:
+        use_nope = getattr(args, "model_type", None) == "kimi_k3"
+    if use_nope:
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] mla_use_nope=True; there is no rotary component "
+            "to normalize -- skipping."
+        )
+        return False
+    pos_dim = getattr(args, "qk_pos_emb_head_dim", None)
+    if pos_dim is not None and pos_dim <= 0:
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] qk_pos_emb_head_dim={pos_dim}; there is no rotary "
+            "component to normalize -- skipping."
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+@register_patch(
+    _PATCH_KEY,
+    backend="megatron",
+    phase="before_train",
+    description=(
+        "Parameter-free RMSNorm (QK-Norm) on the MLA decoupled-RoPE q/k "
+        "components. Caps the rotary attention-logit contribution that bypasses "
+        "q_layernorm/kv_layernorm and escapes qk_clip, fixing the deep-residual "
+        "divergence in the KDA-RoPE hybrid. Enabled via the mla_rope_qk_norm "
+        "config flag or PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1."
+    ),
+    condition=_enabled,
+)
+def patch_mla_rope_qk_norm(ctx: PatchContext) -> None:
+    # ``run_patches`` swallows exceptions (stop_on_error=False) and continues with
+    # the upstream method, which would silently train without a stabilizer the
+    # user explicitly enabled (e.g. after upstream source drift breaks the
+    # anchor). Escalate to a hard abort; ``SystemExit`` is a ``BaseException``
+    # and is not caught by ``run_patches``.
+    try:
+        _install_mla_rope_qk_norm_patch()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        log_rank_0(f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] FATAL: {exc}")
+        raise SystemExit(f"[{_PATCH_KEY}] QK-Norm patch installation failed: {exc}") from exc

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Unit tests for the MLA decoupled-RoPE QK-Norm patch.
+
+Verifies:
+  1. The source anchor still matches upstream ``get_query_key_value_tensors``.
+  2. The patch rewrites the method body (on the defining base class, even when
+     the module attribute is rebound to a subclass) and is idempotent.
+  3. The enable condition honors the flag/env var and the fused-RoPE,
+     cached-latent, NoPE-MLA and zero-width-rotary guards, and the YAML flag turns it on for the
+     shipped KDA MLA hybrid config through the runtime's arg build + merge.
+  4. An install failure aborts the run instead of silently training without QK-Norm.
+  5. On a real (tiny) MLA module, the patched method feeds unit-RMS q/k into
+     the rotary embedding and leaves the content q/k and the value unchanged.
+"""
+
+import inspect
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+pytest.importorskip("megatron")
+
+import megatron.core.transformer.multi_latent_attention as mla_mod
+from megatron.core.transformer.multi_latent_attention import MLASelfAttention
+
+import primus.backends.megatron.patches.mla_rope_qk_norm_patches as patch_mod
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._patch_guard import is_patched
+from primus.core.patches.context import PatchContext
+
+_METHOD = "get_query_key_value_tensors"
+
+
+def _defining_cls():
+    return next(c for c in MLASelfAttention.__mro__ if _METHOD in c.__dict__)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def pristine_method():
+    """Restore the patched method and patch-guard state after each test."""
+    cls = _defining_cls()
+    original = cls.__dict__[_METHOD]
+    yield
+    setattr(cls, _METHOD, original)
+    if hasattr(cls, "_primus_applied_patch_keys"):
+        cls._primus_applied_patch_keys.discard(patch_mod._PATCH_KEY)
+
+
+def test_anchor_matches_upstream():
+    source = inspect.getsource(getattr(_defining_cls(), _METHOD))
+    assert (
+        patch_mod._ORI in source
+    ), "Upstream get_query_key_value_tensors changed; update mla_rope_qk_norm anchor."
+
+
+def test_new_differs_and_normalizes_rotary():
+    assert patch_mod._NEW != patch_mod._ORI
+    assert "torch.rsqrt" in patch_mod._NEW
+    assert "q_pos_emb" in patch_mod._NEW and "k_pos_emb" in patch_mod._NEW
+
+
+def test_install_rewrites_and_is_idempotent(pristine_method, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch_mod, "log_rank_0", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    cls = _defining_cls()
+    original = cls.__dict__[_METHOD]
+
+    patch_mod._install_mla_rope_qk_norm_patch()
+    assert is_patched(cls, patch_mod._PATCH_KEY)
+    first = cls.__dict__[_METHOD]
+    assert first is not original
+
+    patch_mod._install_mla_rope_qk_norm_patch()  # idempotent
+    assert cls.__dict__[_METHOD] is first
+
+
+def test_install_patches_base_when_module_attr_is_rebound(pristine_method, monkeypatch):
+    """mla_patches may rebind the module attribute to a subclass
+    (PrimusMLASelfAttention) while prebuilt layers are base instances."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch_mod, "log_rank_0", lambda *a, **k: None)
+
+    class _Rebound(MLASelfAttention):
+        pass
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mla_mod, "MLASelfAttention", _Rebound)
+    base = _defining_cls()
+    original = base.__dict__[_METHOD]
+
+    patch_mod._install_mla_rope_qk_norm_patch()
+    assert is_patched(base, patch_mod._PATCH_KEY)
+    assert base.__dict__[_METHOD] is not original
+    assert _METHOD not in _Rebound.__dict__
+
+
+def _ctx(**args):
+    return PatchContext(
+        backend="megatron",
+        phase="before_train",
+        extra={"module_config": SimpleNamespace(params=SimpleNamespace(**args))},
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "env, args, expected",
+    [
+        ("1", {}, True),  # env var enables
+        (None, {"mla_rope_qk_norm": True}, True),  # config flag enables
+        (None, {}, False),  # off by default
+        ("1", {"apply_rope_fusion": True}, False),  # fused RoPE -> skip
+        ("1", {"apply_rope_fusion": True, "position_embedding_type": "rope"}, False),
+        # validate_args later drops fusion for non-"rope" models (the MLA hybrids)
+        ("1", {"apply_rope_fusion": True, "position_embedding_type": "none"}, True),
+        ("1", {"cache_mla_latents": True}, False),  # cached latents -> skip
+        ("1", {"mla_use_nope": True}, False),  # NoPE MLA -> skip
+        ("1", {"model_type": "kimi_k3"}, False),  # K3 defaults to NoPE -> skip
+        ("1", {"model_type": "kimi_k3", "mla_use_nope": False}, True),  # K3 with RoPE
+        ("1", {"model_type": "gpt", "mla_use_nope": False}, True),
+        ("1", {"qk_pos_emb_head_dim": 0}, False),  # zero-width rotary -> skip
+        ("1", {"qk_pos_emb_head_dim": 64}, True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_enabled_condition(env, args, expected, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch_mod, "log_rank_0", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    if env is None:
+        monkeypatch.delenv("PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM", raising=False)
+    else:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM", env)
+    ctx = _ctx(**{"mla_rope_qk_norm": False, "apply_rope_fusion": False, **args})
+    assert patch_mod._enabled(ctx) is expected
+
+
+def test_yaml_flag_enables_on_shipped_hybrid_config(monkeypatch):
+    """Mirror ``PrimusRuntime._initialize_trainer`` on the KDA MLA hybrid config:
+    the builder drops the Primus-only key, the params merge puts it back, and the
+    inherited ``apply_rope_fusion: true`` must not skip the patch."""
+    from primus.backends.megatron.argument_builder import MegatronArgBuilder
+    from primus.core.config.yaml_loader import parse_yaml
+    from primus.core.utils.yaml_utils import merge_namespace
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch_mod, "log_rank_0", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM", raising=False)
+    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+    model = parse_yaml(str(repo / "primus/configs/models/megatron/zebra_kda_1B_hybrid.yaml"))
+    assert model["multi_latent_attention"] and model["qk_pos_emb_head_dim"] > 0

+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""
+MLA decoupled-RoPE QK-Norm Patch
+================================
+
+In Multi-Latent Attention the query/key are split into a *content* part
+(``qk_head_dim``) and a *decoupled RoPE* part (``qk_pos_emb_head_dim``). The
+content part is normalized (``q_layernorm`` / ``kv_layernorm`` on the
+compressed latents), but the **rotary part is not normalized anywhere**: it is
+projected, split off, and fed straight into ``apply_rotary_pos_emb``.
+
+For the 3B KDA-RoPE hybrid this is the divergence mechanism. Per-layer
+instrumentation showed that around iter ~22k the deepest ~7 residual layers
+(L49-L55) blow up *together* while the attention logits shoot to 16k-37k --
+far past the ``qk_clip`` threshold (5500). ``qk_clip`` cannot hold them: it
+rescales the per-head weights (content q/k and the rotary q rows of
+``linear_q_(up_)proj``), but the rotary key ``k_pos_emb`` comes straight out of
+``linear_kv_down_proj``, is shared by all heads, and is never rescaled or
+normalized, so the rotary logit term grows through it without bound and
+detonates the deep residual stream.
+
+Fix: apply a **parameter-free RMSNorm** (unit RMS over ``qk_pos_emb_head_dim``)
+to ``q_pos_emb`` and ``k_pos_emb`` before the rotary embedding. Rotary is a
+rotation, so this caps the rotary logit contribution at
+``qk_pos_emb_head_dim`` (``mscale**2 * qk_pos_emb_head_dim`` with YaRN, whose
+cos/sin carry the ``mscale`` factor) regardless of projection-weight growth --
+the real, architectural fix rather than another logit-threshold band-aid.
+
+Why parameter-free (no learnable gain): the run resumes mid-training from an
+existing checkpoint. A learnable RMSNorm gain would add new parameters and
+change the ``state_dict`` / distributed-optimizer param layout, breaking a
+clean resume. Unit-RMS with no parameters keeps the checkpoint and optimizer
+shards byte-compatible while still capping the runaway.
+
+Scope: this rewrites the non-fused training/eval path
+(``apply_rope_fusion: false``, ``cache_mla_latents: false``), which is what the
+hybrid uses. The patch logs a warning and no-ops when RoPE fusion is in effect
+(the fused kernel applies rotary internally; the hybrids' inherited
+``apply_rope_fusion: true`` does not count, since Megatron drops it for
+``position_embedding_type: none``), when MLA latents are cached (a
+different q/k path this anchor was not written for), and for NoPE MLA
+(``mla_use_nope``, the Kimi K3 default), whose 64 positional dims are an
+unrotated pass-through that must stay bit-exact.
+
+This is a "source-string rewrite" patch (see ``_source_patch_utils``): the edit
+sits in the middle of ``MLASelfAttention.get_query_key_value_tensors``'s nested
+``qkv_up_proj_and_rope_apply``, where a wrapping monkey-patch cannot reach.
+``PrimusMLASelfAttention`` inherits this method unchanged, so patching the base
+``MLASelfAttention`` covers the hybrid too.
+
+Enabled via the ``mla_rope_qk_norm`` config flag, or the
+``PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1`` env var (so it needs no config-schema change); a
+no-op otherwise.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._patch_guard import is_patched, mark_patched
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._source_patch_utils import patch_method_source
+from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, get_args, register_patch
+from primus.core.utils.module_utils import log_rank_0
+
+_PATCH_KEY = "megatron.transformer.mla_rope_qk_norm"
+
+# Anchor: the non-fused q/k split immediately followed by the rotary apply on
+# the query. We insert a parameter-free RMSNorm on the decoupled-RoPE q/k parts
+# between the split and the rotary embedding. Written at the upstream file's
+# absolute (16-space) indentation -- patch_method_source replaces on the raw,
+# non-dedented source.
+_ORI = """\
+                # k_no_pe: [num_tokens, n, qk_head_dim]
+                # value: [num_tokens, n, v_head_dim]
+                k_no_pe, value = torch.split(
+                    kv, [self.config.qk_head_dim, self.config.v_head_dim], dim=-1
+                )
+
+                # q_pos_emb: [num_tokens, n, qk_pos_emb_head_dim]
+                q_pos_emb = apply_rotary_pos_emb("""
+
+_NEW = """\
+                # k_no_pe: [num_tokens, n, qk_head_dim]
+                # value: [num_tokens, n, v_head_dim]
+                k_no_pe, value = torch.split(
+                    kv, [self.config.qk_head_dim, self.config.v_head_dim], dim=-1
+                )
+
+                # --- MLA decoupled-RoPE QK-Norm (parameter-free) ---
+                # The rotary q/k parts bypass q_layernorm/kv_layernorm and also
+                # escape qk_clip, so their magnitude can grow unbounded and drive
+                # the attention-logit / deep-residual explosion. Normalize each
+                # head's rotary vector to unit RMS (rotary is a rotation, so this
+                # bounds the rotary logit contribution at qk_pos_emb_head_dim,
+                # times mscale**2 under YaRN) without adding parameters -- keeps
+                # the checkpoint/optimizer layout identical for a clean resume.
+                _qkn_eps = self.config.layernorm_epsilon
+                q_pos_emb = q_pos_emb * torch.rsqrt(
+                    q_pos_emb.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + _qkn_eps
+                ).to(q_pos_emb.dtype)
+                k_pos_emb = k_pos_emb * torch.rsqrt(
+                    k_pos_emb.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + _qkn_eps
+                ).to(k_pos_emb.dtype)
+
+                # q_pos_emb: [num_tokens, n, qk_pos_emb_head_dim]
+                q_pos_emb = apply_rotary_pos_emb("""
+
+
+def _install_mla_rope_qk_norm_patch() -> None:
+    from megatron.core.transformer.multi_latent_attention import MLASelfAttention
+
+    # Another patch may rebind this module attribute to a subclass
+    # (PrimusMLASelfAttention). ``get_query_key_value_tensors`` is defined on the
+    # upstream base and prebuilt hybrid layers may be base instances, so patch the
+    # class that actually defines the method (walk the MRO) rather than whatever
+    # the attribute currently points at.
+    target = next(c for c in MLASelfAttention.__mro__ if "get_query_key_value_tensors" in c.__dict__)
+
+    if is_patched(target, _PATCH_KEY):
+        log_rank_0(f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] already applied; skipping.")
+        return
+
+    patch_method_source(target, "get_query_key_value_tensors", _ORI, _NEW)
+
+    mark_patched(target, _PATCH_KEY)
+    log_rank_0(
+        f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] Applied parameter-free RMSNorm to the MLA "
+        "decoupled-RoPE q/k components (non-fused path)."
+    )
+
+
+def _enabled(ctx: PatchContext) -> bool:
+    args = get_args(ctx)
+    # Enable via the ``mla_rope_qk_norm`` config flag if present, or the
+    # ``PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1`` env var (works without a config-schema change).
+    if not getattr(args, "mla_rope_qk_norm", False) and os.environ.get("PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM", "0") != "1":
+        return False
+    # The fused RoPE kernel applies rotary internally; this source patch only
+    # covers the explicit non-fused split path. Warn + no-op if fusion is on.
+    # This runs before Megatron's validate_args (called inside pretrain), which
+    # forces apply_rope_fusion off unless position_embedding_type == "rope". The
+    # MLA hybrids inherit apply_rope_fusion: true with position_embedding_type:
+    # none and still run the non-fused MLA rotary path, so judge the effective value.
+    rope_fused = (
+        getattr(args, "apply_rope_fusion", False)
+        and getattr(args, "position_embedding_type", "rope") == "rope"
+    )
+    if rope_fused:
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] apply_rope_fusion=True; QK-Norm patch only "
+            "supports the non-fused path -- skipping (rotary q/k stay unnormalized)."
+        )
+        return False
+    if getattr(args, "cache_mla_latents", False):
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:{_PATCH_KEY}] cache_mla_latents=True; QK-Norm patch only "
+            "supports the non-cached path -- skipping (rotary q/k stay unnormalized)."
+        )
+        return False
+    # NoPE MLA (Kimi K3) still routes its positional dims through this block but
+    # relies on a zero-width rotary table being a bit-exact pass-through, so
+    # normalizing them would change the model. KimiK3TransformerConfig defaults
+    # mla_use_nope to True, so a K3 run without the arg is NoPE too.
+    use_nope = getattr(args, "mla_use_nope", None)
+    if use_nope is None:
+        use_nope = getattr(args, "model_type", None) == "kimi_k3"

Addressed the open Copilot findings in 26dbe79b:

- **Cached MLA latents:** the patch now no-ops with a log line when `cache_mla_latents=True`.
- **Kimi K3 / NoPE MLA:** the patch now no-ops when `mla_use_nope` is set, or when a `kimi_k3` run leaves it at its `True` default, so K3 attention values are unchanged.
- **Docs:** the skip conditions are listed, and the example `qk_clip_threshold` is now 100 (was 5500) to match the ~65 healthy max logit with QK-Norm on.
- **Tests:** `test_enabled_condition` covers both new guards plus K3 with RoPE. 12/12 pass in `rocm/primus:v26.5` against the pinned Megatron-LM, and the three new skip cases fail on the previous commit.

The earlier `run-unittest-torch` failure was `test_torchtitan_trainer.py::test_llama3_1_8B_FP8` (grad=inf at step 1), in the TorchTitan backend this PR does not touch; all 3210 unit tests and the 19 Megatron trainer tests passed in that run.

Re the review summary ("the documented config path is nonfunctional"): confirmed and fixed in 7be6c9f9.

`before_train` patches run before Megatron's `validate_args` (that is called inside `pretrain()`), and `validate_args` is what forces `apply_rope_fusion` off when `position_embedding_type != "rope"`. The KDA/GDN/Mamba MLA hybrids (`zebra_*_hybrid.yaml`) inherit `apply_rope_fusion: true` from `language_model.yaml` with `position_embedding_type: none`. So the fusion guard saw `True` and skipped QK-Norm, even though the model then runs the non-fused MLA rotary path. Both `mla_rope_qk_norm: true` and `PRIMUS_MLA_ROPE_QK_NORM=1` were no-ops on exactly the configs this targets. (The YAML key itself does reach the patch: the arg builder drops it and the runtime's params merge restores it before `before_train`.)

The guard now checks the effective value (`apply_rope_fusion and position_embedding_type == "rope"`). The new `test_yaml_flag_enables_on_shipped_hybrid_config` loads `zebra_kda_1B_hybrid.yaml`, runs it through `MegatronArgBuilder` and `merge_namespace` as `PrimusRuntime` does, and asserts the patch enables. It and the new `position_embedding_type: none` case fail on the previous commit and pass now: 17/17 in `rocm/primus:v26.5` on MI355X.
